candidates.tagline: Sandbach's £6,200 bike ramp on stairs: pedal met fence post, 4M people watched
candidates.story: On November 21, 2026, Mayor Sam Corcoran opened a new £6,200 bike channel on the stairs at Sandbach railway station in Cheshire, filming himself riding up — only for his left pedal to strike a fence post at the top; the video went viral with over 4 million views on X, with critics noting nobody had measured the channel wide enough to clear a standard bike's pedal width, while campaigners are now leveraging the global media coverage to push for the actual accessibility need: a lift to Platform 2.
candidates.why_funny: The solution to 'bikes can't get up these stairs' cost £6,200 and was inaugurated with a ceremonial pedal-meets-fence-post moment for 4 million witnesses.
candidates.alt: Screenshot from Mayor Sam Corcoran's viral video showing him wheeling a bicycle up the new bike channel on Sandbach railway station's stairs, with his left pedal caught on the railing at the top

candidates.tagline: Microsoft's AI doctor for slow PCs was secretly eating 860MB of your RAM
candidates.story: At Ignite 2026 in November, Microsoft admitted its own background apps — Defender, OneDrive, Purview, and Microsoft 365 — were collectively consuming 860MB of RAM on Windows 11 PCs without users knowing; Copilot itself uses up to 1GB idle while advertising the ability to diagnose why your PC runs slowly; Microsoft has since freed that memory and is removing force-installed Copilot-heavy Microsoft 365 apps from enterprise Windows 11, saying they 'came at a very high cost' — weeks after telling users that 8GB RAM is 'a great fit for everyday Windows 11 use.'
candidates.why_funny: Windows 11's AI health tool, advertised as diagnosing why your PC runs slowly, was itself running on a gigabyte of silently-installed Microsoft bloatware — the patient was the doctor.
candidates.alt: Windows 11 performance comparison graphic showing RAM usage before and after Microsoft freed nearly 900MB previously consumed by its own force-installed apps including Defender, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365
